text:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up: we've confirmed an onboarding interruption impacting tenants provisioned between Mar 10–12 due to an auth token rotation edge case. I exported an impacted list to Notion and flagged high-touch customers. Will post a customer-facing template + compensation plan shortly. Ping me if you need any accounts prioritized.

samir_se: Can we have one canonical outbound we can personalize? Needs: short apology, plain-language root cause, what we fixed, current status, ETA for final verification, compensation details, office hours invite, and a short feedback survey.

jess_engineer: Patch started EU rollout at 16:42 UTC (eu-redwood-01); US rollout ongoing. Root cause: KMS-triggered token refresh caused some edge auth caches to invalidate during retries, producing intermittent 401s. Fixes: stop aggressive cache eviction on rotation + backfill tokens for affected sessions. Error rate trending down to baseline.

opsbot: deploy eu-redwood-01 finished; status=partial_success; error_rate=0.6% -> monitoring.

ryan_csm: Good. For high-touch accounts add an exec outreach option and offer 1:1 troubleshooting. Keep the public copy concise.

maria_cs: Draft outbound below — quick review. Targeting segmented sends by COB. Also scheduling an enablement office hours: Thu 15:00 PT (recording will be shared). Survey link included.

```
Hi <Customer name>,

We9re sorry 5 you may have experienced onboarding interruptions between Mar 10	2012 while we rotated authentication tokens.

What happened (short): during a token rotation a small percentage of sessions saw 401 errors while caches were refreshed.
What we did: deployed a patch to prevent aggressive cache eviction, backfilled affected tokens, and closely monitored cluster health.
Current status: rollout in progress; most affected accounts recovered within minutes of the patch.
Compensation: we will apply a one-time onboarding credit (prorated) to accounts impacted during the window and offer up to 2 hours of live enablement with our solutions team.
Next steps: join our live office hours Thu 15:00 PT (link below) or reply to this message/support@redwood.ai to request 1:1 troubleshooting. Please take our short survey after the session so we can improve.

Thanks for your patience.
5 Redwood Inference Customer Success
```

jess_engineer: Add KB + FAQ link: https://internal.redwood/kb/token-rotation and a quick self-troubleshoot curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/auth/rotate -H \"Authorization: Bearer <admin_token>\"`

laura_prod: +1 to KB and curl. PS: if you still see 401s, rotate client-side tokens or clear local cache per KB. I'll confirm ledger id and the automation script for credits and reply with the batch id.

samir_se: I will own segmentation and cadence: high-touch gets personalized email + 1:1 invite; mid-tier gets templated email + office-hours invite; self-serve sees an inline in-app notice with KB links. Drafts to you by 17:30.

maria_cs: Action items: @samir_se send segmented outbound, @jess_engineer attach KB and remediation snippet, @laura_prod confirm credit ledger/automation, I9ll schedule office hours and post the link in the outbound. Tracking in #cs-incident-tracker. Final outbound to be posted in #customer-comms by 18:00. :thumbsup:

opsbot: support-batch created id=9987; awaiting ledger confirmation from @laura_prod.

ryan_csm: I9ll send a list of flagged renewal-risk customers for possible exec outreach and to track churn risk.

maria_cs: Thanks all 5 reconvene in 30m if anything blocks send.
